label: positive

blockers.detail: public headers moved to include/, library to src/lib/; harness build still uses -I. and .libs/libcares.a

rationale_zh: 该提交重组源码树：公共头文件移入 include/，库源码与产物移入 src/lib/。harness 的构建配置（OSS-Fuzz build.sh）仍用 -I. 查找 ares.h、链接 .libs/libcares.a，test/ares-test-fuzz.c 因找不到 ares.h 而编译失败。harness 代码本身未变，坏在构建配置上，属于本次引入的显式 configuration 退化；维护者两天后在 oss-fuzz 008f2177e 把路径改为 -Iinclude -Isrc/lib 与 src/lib/.libs/libcares.a。
rationale_en: The commit reorganises the source tree: public headers move to include/, library sources and the built archive to src/lib/. The harness build configuration (OSS-Fuzz build.sh) still compiles with -I. and links .libs/libcares.a, so test/ares-test-fuzz.c fails to compile (ares.h not found). The harness code itself is unchanged; its build configuration is what broke. Explicit configuration degradation introduced by this change; fixed two days later in oss-fuzz 008f2177e (-Iinclude -Isrc/lib, src/lib/.libs/libcares.a).
